schema.text: When you cycle, do other cyclists make you feel unsafe?

ar.#When you cycle, do other cyclists make: عند ركوب الدراجة، هل يُشعرك من يركبون الدراجات الآخرون بعدم الأمان؟

de.#When you cycle, do other cyclists make: Fühlen Sie sich beim Radfahren durch andere Radfahrende unsicher?

en.#When you cycle, do other cyclists make: When you cycle, do other cyclists make you feel unsafe?

fa.#When you cycle, do other cyclists make: هنگام دوچرخه‌سواری، آیا دیگر دوچرخه‌سواران باعث می‌شوند احساس ناامنی کنید؟

fr.#When you cycle, do other cyclists make: Lorsque vous faites du vélo, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des autres cyclistes ?

hu.#When you cycle, do other cyclists make: Kerékpározás közben a többi kerékpáros miatt érzi magát veszélyben?

it.#When you cycle, do other cyclists make: Quando vai in bici, altre persone in bici ti fanno sentire in pericolo?

tr.#When you cycle, do other cyclists make: Bisiklet sürerken diğer bisikletliler kendinizi güvensiz hissetmenize neden oluyor mu?
